areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: Port electrification (shore power, charging stations) with funding and an emissions indicator; moderate impact given target population and resources.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: High adherence: port infrastructure for cargo handling; significant resources; indicator with complementary private investment; high impact, efficient solutions, strong multiplier effect.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Solar plant supplying shore power with an emissions indicator; scope limited to local energy management and complementary to decarbonization, so low impact.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Adherence claimed, but no objective, component, product, indicator or resources aimed at sustainable cities or urban investments.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Resilient infrastructure claimed, but nothing in objectives, components, indicators or resources targets risk prevention or adaptation capacity.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Job and income gains are means to other objectives, not a project focused on decent work for the poorest.

areas.name: Logistics and transport
areas.reason: Objectives and components aligned, but no indicators or targets showing achievement; minimum criteria not met.

areas.name: Trade
areas.reason: Potential contribution to trade diversification, but no specific objective, indicators or targets; minimum criteria not met.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Regional development effects are indirect results of port infrastructure; nothing aimed directly at reducing regional inequality.

areas.name: International cooperation and regional development
areas.reason: No objective, indicator or resources for cooperation; the lender's role does not count since it applies to every external financing.
